conversion.method: piano MIDI-event JSON to solo classical-guitar arrangement
adaptations: notes outside classical-guitar range moved by octaves
simultaneous textures reduced to maximum six notes
each note assigned to a specific string and fret

project.title: In the Hall of the Mountain King - Classical Guitar
project.alternate_title: Dans l'antre du roi de la montagne
project.work: Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46 No. 4

arrangement_notes.important: This is a playable-oriented solo-guitar adaptation of the MIDI performance, not a note-for-note guitar transcription. Piano textures exceeding guitar range or six simultaneous strings were revoiced.
